data.name: AMAR1001_Title
data.value: Factory method owner must be a plain class

data.name: AMAR1001_Message
data.value: The owner class '{1}' of factory method '{0}' must be a plain instantiable class, not abstract/static/interface/struct or generic.

data.name: AMAR1002_Title
data.value: Class containing factory methods cannot have registration attributes

data.name: AMAR1002_Message
data.value: The class '{0}' containing factory methods is auto-registered as a singleton; remove the registration attribute(s) on the class.

data.name: AMAR1003_Title
data.value: Factory method cannot be static

data.name: AMAR1003_Message
data.value: The factory method '{0}' must be an instance method, not static.

data.name: AMAR1004_Title
data.value: Factory method must be public

data.name: AMAR1004_Message
data.value: The factory method '{0}' must be public so generated code can call it.

data.name: AMAR1005_Title
data.value: Factory method cannot be generic

data.name: AMAR1005_Message
data.value: The factory method '{0}' cannot be a generic method; generic factory methods are not supported.

data.name: AMAR1006_Title
data.value: Factory method cannot return void

data.name: AMAR1006_Message
data.value: The factory method '{0}' must not return void; its return type is the service type.

data.name: AMAR1007_Title
data.value: Factory method return type must be a resolvable named type

data.name: AMAR1007_Message
data.value: The return type of factory method '{0}' must be a reference type (a class or interface); closed generics like List<int> are registered as-is, while value types, arrays, pointers, and unbound generics are not supported.

data.name: AMAR1008_Title
data.value: Invalid number of factory method parameters

data.name: AMAR1008_Message
data.value: The factory method '{0}' supports only no parameters or a single IServiceProvider parameter.

data.name: AMAR1009_Title
data.value: The single parameter must be IServiceProvider

data.name: AMAR1009_Message
data.value: The single parameter of factory method '{0}' must be System.IServiceProvider.

data.name: AMAR1010_Title
data.value: Singleton factory method cannot take IServiceProvider

data.name: AMAR1010_Message
data.value: A singleton factory method '{0}' must have no parameters; dependencies should come from the constructor injection of its owning class.

data.name: AMAR2001_Title
data.value: Registration attribute on an unsupported target

data.name: AMAR2001_Message
data.value: The registration attribute on member '{0}' is invalid; registration attributes are only valid on classes and ordinary methods.

data.name: AMAR2002_Title
data.value: Service type must be an interface or class

data.name: AMAR2002_Message
data.value: The service type '{0}' of a registration attribute must be an interface or class; closed generic types (e.g. InterfaceA<int>) are registered as-is, while open/unbound generics (e.g. InterfaceA<>), arrays, pointers, and value types are not supported.

data.name: AMAR2003_Title
data.value: Generic classes cannot be registered

data.name: AMAR2003_Message
data.value: Generic class '{0}' cannot be registered; close the generic arguments or register manually.

data.name: AMAR2005_Title
data.value: Duplicate registration

data.name: AMAR2005_Message
data.value: Duplicate registration of service '{0}' with implementation '{1}' (key: {2}); the last registration wins, please confirm this is intended.

data.name: AMAR3001_Title
data.value: [AutoRegister] method must be partial

data.name: AMAR3001_Message
data.value: The [AutoRegister] method '{0}' must be declared partial so the generator can provide the implementation.

data.name: AMAR3002_Title
data.value: The containing class must be partial

data.name: AMAR3002_Message
data.value: The class '{1}' containing the [AutoRegister] method '{0}' must be partial.

data.name: AMAR3003_Title
data.value: [AutoRegister] method cannot have a manual implementation

data.name: AMAR3003_Message
data.value: The [AutoRegister] method '{0}' already has an implementation; remove it and let the generator provide it.

data.name: AMAR3004_Title
data.value: [AutoRegister] method must be static

data.name: AMAR3004_Message
data.value: The [AutoRegister] method '{0}' must be static.

data.name: AMAR3005_Title
data.value: [AutoRegister] method signature must be (IServiceCollection services)

data.name: AMAR3005_Message
data.value: The [AutoRegister] method '{0}' must have the signature (IServiceCollection services).

data.name: AMAR3006_Title
data.value: No registerable services found in the assembly

data.name: AMAR3006_Message
data.value: No classes or methods with registration attributes were found in the assembly; check for typos in attribute names.

data.name: AMAR3007_Title
data.value: Only one [AutoRegister] method is allowed per assembly

data.name: AMAR3007_Message
data.value: Only one [AutoRegister] method is allowed per assembly; '{0}' already exists, remove the extra method '{1}'.

data.name: AMAR4001_Title
data.value: Missing [RegistrationOptions]

data.name: AMAR4001_Message
data.value: The BaseServiceAttribute subclass '{0}' must be decorated with [RegistrationOptions].

data.name: AMAR4002_Title
data.value: [RegistrationOptions] index exceeds constructor parameter count

data.name: AMAR4002_Message
data.value: The [RegistrationOptions] '{0}' index ({1}) exceeds the number of constructor parameters of attribute '{2}'.

data.name: AMAR4003_Title
data.value: [RegistrationOptions] index points to a parameter of the wrong type

data.name: AMAR4003_Message
data.value: The [RegistrationOptions] '{0}' index of attribute '{2}' points to a constructor parameter of the wrong type (expected {1}).

data.name: AMAR4004_Title
data.value: Invalid lifetime value

data.name: AMAR4004_Message
data.value: The lifetime value of registration attribute '{0}' is invalid; only Singleton/Scoped/Transient are supported.

data.name: AMAR4005_Title
data.value: Multiple [RegistrationOptions] on the inheritance chain

data.name: AMAR4005_Message
data.value: Multiple [RegistrationOptions] were found on the inheritance chain of '{0}'; only the nearest one is used, remove the redundant ones.

data.name: AMAR2007_Title
data.value: Implementation type is not compatible with the service type

data.name: AMAR2007_Message
data.value: Implementation type '{0}' cannot be converted to service type '{1}'; check the generic target or the typeof(...) argument.

data.name: AMAR2008_Title
data.value: Implementation type cannot be instantiated

data.name: AMAR2008_Message
data.value: Implementation type '{0}' is abstract or static and cannot be instantiated; remove the registration attribute or use a concrete type.

data.name: AMAR2009_Title
data.value: Duplicate service key for the same target type

data.name: AMAR2009_Message
data.value: Service type '{0}' already has a registration with key {1} (implementation '{2}'); keys must be unique per target type.

data.name: AMAR4006_Title
data.value: Generic registration attribute has too many type parameters

data.name: AMAR4006_Message
data.value: Generic registration attribute '{0}' has {1} type parameters; only one type parameter (the target type) is supported.

data.name: AMAR4007_Title
data.value: Conflicting service types in the registration attribute

data.name: AMAR4007_Message
data.value: The generic target type '{0}' conflicts with the constructor service type '{1}' on '{2}'; specify the service type in only one place.
